verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs show it handles policies: the AI Agent drafts policies (vanta-docs-15, vanta-docs-36), policies can be listed and uploaded through the API (vanta-docs-1, vanta-docs-23), and agentic search covers policies (vanta-docs-70). None of the story's specific workflow elements are evidenced, so this is only glancing support. missing for 10: a lawyer-grade policy template library, an in-app policy editor, policy versioning, approval workflows, per-employee policy acceptance tracking, and independent corroboration.
